# generated from spec/capabilities/c1.md by features generate; do not edit
Feature: C1
  Narrator: the tool `work`

  @g1 @r1
  Scenario: every in response
    Given an item i1
    And the status of the item i1 is `ready`
    And an item i2
    And the status of the item i2 is `ready`
    When the person runs `work batch start`
    Then the batch b1 holds the item i1
    And the batch b1 holds the item i2
    And `work` prints the batch b1
